panels.name: C10: effort pairs with cost differences

notes.printed: Costs are the mean list cost of one sample (for Opus, its one answer); the cost difference is low effort minus medium effort. The file's own words for the status: "exploratory: no Holm, no verdict".

Where both settings are at the ceiling, the bootstrap interval of d collapses to one point (marked collapsed). The difference itself has no exact interval in free analysis 4, which gives each setting's exact 95% interval instead (Clopper–Pearson over puzzles), printed in that setting's accuracy cell as post hoc† (exact): a presentation only, not a test.

interval.printed: 95% intervals. Shared cluster bootstrap for C2, C3, the C5 interaction and C9 (2,000 draws, stamped on C2 and C9); paired BCa bootstrap for Tests 1 and 2 in the C5 panel (their confirmatory intervals, B = 10,000) and for the C10 effort pairs (B = 10,000); exact Clopper–Pearson for the post hoc per-setting intervals at the ceiling.

n.printed: puzzles: 80; samples per puzzle and shape as in TAB-04 (the Haiku settings' accuracies are means over their samples)

set.printed: the Study 1 main-run puzzle set at 6 steps: each puzzle as a chain (1×6) and as pieces (6×1)

notes.printed: C2 is the correlation, across the puzzles, of each puzzle's accuracy at 6×1 and at 1×6 (Pearson for the Haiku settings, phi for one-sample settings); C3 is the paired difference 6×1 minus 1×6. A correlation is undefined where a setting has no variation at one shape (the cell shows the stamped text).

For the Haiku arms that is each puzzle's share right of its tries; for one-try arms it is 0/1, which gives the phi coefficient. Shared cluster bootstrap 95%. Descriptive".
